notes.title: Streaming Forbidden
notes.notes:
I came to a conclusion that 'Blood Moon' is not very suitable for streaming.
From May 4th onwards, streaming is not allowed. [b]No recordings allowed.[/b]
If you really need to stream the game online, please contact me.
circustokki@gmail.com

notes.title: Most of the English and Japanese support issues have been fixed
notes.notes:
Most of the English and Japanese support issues have been fixed. 
If you find any more errors, please send to circustokki@gmail.com instead of posting on forum.

notes.title: About English and Japanese Support Error
notes.notes:
The error occurs when the game is run on a pc without Korean installed due to some codes being in Korean.
The error may be fixed if Korean is installed on the pc, 
but I understand that this is not the solution you are looking for.
I started fixing this issue just after I read about the error on the forum. 
I will provide a patch in two days. 
I sincerely apologize for the error.
If any similar type of error occurs, posting on forum may spoil the storyline to other users, 
so please send me the images or video files to  circustokki@gmail.com

notes.title: Rules on Streaming
notes.notes:
Streaming Forbidden
I came to a conclusion that 'Blood Moon' is not very suitable for streaming.
From May 4th onwards, streaming is not allowed.
If you really need to stream the game online, please contact me.

[strike]I do not mind streaming the game online, 
but please do not expose any important scenes or illustrations on thumbnails.
[/strike]
